user.title: UniFi AI Speaker
user.description: Connect to your UniFi Protect console's local Integration API. Create an API key in Protect under Settings → Control Plane → Integrations.

data_description.host: Example: 10.1.0.29 (scheme and path are added automatically).
data_description.verify_ssl: UniFi Protect consoles use a self-signed certificate on the LAN, so this is usually off. Leaving it off skips TLS verification for this console only; enable it if your console presents a trusted certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate UniFi AI Speaker
reauth_confirm.description: The stored API key was rejected. Enter a new API key for this console.

reconfigure.title: Edit UniFi AI Speaker
reconfigure.description: Update the console connection used by this integration.

data_description.host: Example: 10.1.0.29 (scheme and path are added automatically).
data_description.api_key: Leave blank to keep the currently stored API key.
data_description.verify_ssl: UniFi Protect consoles use a self-signed certificate on the LAN, so this is usually off.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the console. Check the host and that the Integration API is enabled.
error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected. Check the key and its permissions.
error.no_speakers: Connected successfully, but no AI Speakers were found on this console.
error.already_configured: Another UniFi AI Speaker entry already uses this console.

data_description.restore_delay: How long after a disarm-mute to restore the saved volume. Default 600 seconds (10 minutes).
data_description.alarm_panel: Optional, no YAML needed. If set, every speaker on this entry is automatically muted when this panel goes from triggered to disarmed, and the mute is cancelled immediately if the panel re-arms or re-triggers. Leave empty to keep the integration decoupled and drive it only via the unifi_ai_speaker.* services in your own automations/Alarmo actions.

mute_for_alarm_disarm.name: Mute for alarm disarm
mute_for_alarm_disarm.description: Save the speaker's current volume, set it to 0 so UniFi Alarm Manager playback is instantly silent, and schedule a restore after a delay (default 10 minutes).

restore_delay.name: Restore delay
restore_delay.description: Seconds to wait before restoring the saved volume. Omit to use the integration option (default 600 seconds).

restore_alarm_volume.name: Restore alarm volume
restore_alarm_volume.description: Immediately restore the speaker's saved volume and clear the alarm mute.

cancel_alarm_mute.name: Cancel alarm mute
cancel_alarm_mute.description: Cancel a pending restore and restore the saved volume at once. Use when the alarm re-arms or re-triggers.
